description: Get cvrt-seo-manager status: { version, configured, permalinks, dependencies: { php, wordpress }, features }. features (cvrt-seo-manager 1.15.0+) lists capabilities: migrate_dry_run (seo_import_migrate honours dry_run for the per-post pass; without it the tool refuses a per-post dry run), sitemap_health (seo_sitemap_health available), redirect_audit (GET /redirects/audit), migrate_external_targets (seo_import_migrate takes allow_external_targets; RankMath redirects to another host are imported disabled and listed in warnings). Older versions have no features field.
name: seo_status
